strings.rounds.title: ACK Voice Studio: training rounds
strings.rounds.usage.back: back [--project name]: choose the round that the chosen one continued from. Asks first. Removes nothing.
strings.rounds.usage.choose: choose number [--project name]: make that round the one the next round continues from. Asks first. Removes nothing.
strings.rounds.usage.free: free [--saved rounds] [--working rounds] [--all] [--project name]: show what could be freed up, with sizes. Say which with --saved, --working or --all and it shows exactly what it will remove, and asks first. Only spare saved files and old working files.
strings.rounds.usage.head: Commands:
strings.rounds.usage.keep: keep [--project name]: show which saved files are kept for sure and which are spare. Changes nothing.
strings.rounds.usage.list: list [--project name]: show every round, which one is chosen, and what the next one will continue from. Changes nothing.
strings.rounds.usage.note: note number --text words [--project name]: write a note on a round. Asks first. An empty text removes the note.
strings.rounds.usage.options: --yes answers yes to the question a command asks. A training set is a folder in the project's scratch folder; start lists them if you leave --set out.
strings.rounds.usage.start: start --set name [--minutes n] [--project name]: train one more round. It continues from the chosen round, or from the starting voice if none is chosen yet. Asks first.
strings.rounds.usage.stop: stop [--project name]: ask the running round to stop. It saves what it can first. Asks first.

strings.startvoice.says.amy_recordings: Amy's model card names the recordings this voice was trained on, but gives their licence only as a pointer to a web page. That page does not mention Amy or state a licence for these recordings, so the licence is not established.
strings.startvoice.says.lessac_ends: Either side can end the agreement by written notice. The user must then destroy every copy of the recordings.
strings.startvoice.says.lessac_origin: The lessac voice was trained from scratch on the Blizzard 2013 recordings.
strings.startvoice.says.lessac_terms: Their licence page is a Research Licence Agreement. It says the recordings are for research purposes only. It rules out any commercial purpose, including developing or selling voice products or services.
strings.startvoice.says.lessac_unsettled: The page does not say whether any of this reaches a voice trained from the recordings. That question is not settled here.
strings.startvoice.says.made_from_lessac: This voice was made by training further from the lessac voice.
strings.startvoice.says.mike_recordings: Mike's model card names the recordings this voice was trained on and lists their licence as CC0. The page for those recordings says they are licensed under CC0 (public domain).

strings.voicezip.error.write_failed.next: Check the folder and the free space, then try again.
strings.voicezip.error.write_failed.what: The zip could not be written.
strings.voicezip.problem.config_empty: The voice's settings file is empty.
strings.voicezip.problem.config_missing: The voice's settings file is missing.
strings.voicezip.problem.config_not_json: The voice's settings file cannot be read.
strings.voicezip.problem.config_not_piper: The voice's settings file does not look like a Piper voice's settings.
strings.voicezip.problem.config_too_big: The voice's settings file is larger than ACK accepts.
strings.voicezip.problem.model_too_big: The voice file is larger than ACK on the phone accepts.
strings.voicezip.problem.not_onnx: This is not a voice file the phone can use.
strings.voicezip.problem.not_patched: The voice file has not been prepared for the phone yet. Without that step, ACK would stop on the first word it tries to say.
strings.voicezip.problem.rate_mismatch: The voice file and its settings file disagree about the sound quality, so they do not belong together.
strings.voicezip.problem.speakers_mismatch: The voice file and its settings file disagree about how many voices it holds, so they do not belong together.
strings.voicezip.problem.wrong_comment: The voice file does not say it is a Piper voice, so the phone would not treat it as one.
strings.voicezip.problem.zip_too_big: The zip is larger than ACK accepts.
strings.voicezip.problem.zip_unreadable: The file is not a zip file ACK can open.
strings.voicezip.problem.zip_wrong_entries: The zip does not hold the two files ACK looks for, under the names ACK expects.
